description: This file extends the 'account.move.line' model in Odoo to add a custom link between supplier invoice lines and banks, including a method 'line2bank' to retrieve bank associations for move lines.

classes.name: AccountMoveLine
classes.description: A class inheriting from osv.osv to extend account.move.line with custom bank linking functionality.

methods.name: line2bank
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of move line IDs to bank IDs, linking supplier invoice lines to banks based on certain conditions.
